calculation_handling.description: Minimum 2.0 m above-ground separation between facing main walls of the same townhouse or apartment building in the R zone when neither wall has openings to dwelling units.
calculation_handling.gaps: The arm applies only when there are no openings to dwelling units in either main wall; the wall-opening condition is a design fact with no lot_condition token or DSL input, so it is not keyed as a condition and the arm is selected by the user's design. Separation is measured between main walls of the same building where a perpendicular line from one intercepts the other.

calculation_handling.description: Minimum 5.5 m above-ground separation between facing main walls of the same townhouse or apartment building in the R zone when one of the walls has no openings to dwelling units.
calculation_handling.gaps: The arm applies only when one of the facing main walls has no openings to dwelling units; the wall-opening condition is a design fact with no lot_condition token or DSL input, so it is not keyed as a condition and the arm is selected by the user's design. Separation is measured between main walls of the same building where a perpendicular line from one intercepts the other.

calculation_handling.description: Minimum 11.0 m above-ground separation between facing main walls of the same townhouse or apartment building in the R zone when each wall has an opening to a dwelling unit.
calculation_handling.gaps: The arm applies only when each facing main wall has an opening to a dwelling unit; the wall-opening condition is a design fact with no lot_condition token or DSL input, so it is not keyed as a condition and the arm is selected by the user's design. Separation is measured between main walls of the same building where a perpendicular line from one intercepts the other.

calculation_handling.description: Minimum 5.5 m above-ground separation between main walls of two or more townhouses / apartment buildings on the same R-zone lot abutting a major street, when one or more of the walls has no openings to dwelling units.
calculation_handling.gaps: The arm applies only when the main wall of one or more of the buildings has no openings to dwelling units; the wall-opening condition is a design fact with no lot_condition token or DSL input, so it is not keyed as a condition. The clause also requires two or more townhouses or apartment buildings on the same lot (a scenario fact, no token).

calculation_handling.description: Minimum 11.0 m above-ground separation between main walls of two or more townhouses / apartment buildings on the same R-zone lot abutting a major street, when each wall has an opening to a dwelling unit.
calculation_handling.gaps: The arm applies only when each main wall has an opening to a dwelling unit; the wall-opening condition is a design fact with no lot_condition token or DSL input, so it is not keyed as a condition. The clause also requires two or more townhouses or apartment buildings on the same lot (a scenario fact, no token).

10.10.40.80(1).explanation: In the R zone, where two main walls of the same townhouse or apartment building face each other, they must be at least 2.0 m apart if neither has windows or doors to homes, 5.5 m apart if only one has them, and 11.0 m apart if both do.

10.10.40.80(2).explanation: In the R zone, where two or more townhouses or apartment buildings stand on the same lot on a major street, the main walls of the separate buildings must be at least 5.5 m apart if one wall has no windows or doors to homes, and 11.0 m apart if each wall has them.
